task_instance: In-chat request from SKILL.md example 3: produce a Globestudio studio link for a flat dotted map of Japan in brand green (#16a34a) on the Default look, to drop on a slide, and hand it back with a one-sentence description.
evidence: The chat path of this skill is pure text work: build a JSON design config, URL-encode it, and assemble the studio link; no code execution, binary, network, or credentials are needed, and the skill states a chat agent cannot and need not render/export. Produced japan_globe_config.json holding the compact config {v:3, selection=country:JPN, dotColor=#16a34a, viewMode=flat}. Hand-computed encodeURIComponent of JSON.stringify(config) to %7B%22v%22%3A3%2C%22selection%22%3A%22country%3AJPN%22%2C%22dotColor%22%3A%22%2316a34a%22%2C%22viewMode%22%3A%22flat%22%7D and assembled the look-default studio link (base address is a redaction placeholder in this copy that I did not guess) in deliverable.md with the one-sentence description. Verified against SKILL.md rules: all keys are app-kept keys, selection uses an uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (JPN), v=3 so the hex renders exactly, the Default look keeps dotColor, the '#' is encoded as %23 so it cannot truncate the config, and the ~110-char encoded config is far under the 32000-char limit. Files: japan_globe_config.json, deliverable.md, result.json in the work directory.
